message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of an agent-driven memory workflow that turns a conversation transcript into an evolving memory and uses it to answer a question.","description":"A flow diagram shows memory principles and a memory action space on the left, alongside a transcript store containing 272 turns. An agent inspects the transcript, searches and audits source turns, reads and revises memory, and reviews memory quality. This produces a memory profile with user details, stable sneaker preferences, people, and locations. In an example exchange below, the agent answers that one day passed between the two shoe purchases.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
